findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Sampah kampus, jadi saldo." → 3 lines (4 words, 70.2px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.
Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 of 8 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 4, 6.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 768px: "Menabung sampah dari kantin dan kos , me…" → 4 lines at 29.1px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 332px of the width empty: "Mulai dari satu kantong.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
